description: This file contains React components and utility functions for rendering links, attachments, trace links, and managing URL search parameters within a web-based HTML report viewer for test results.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: React component that conditionally renders children based on a predicate applied to URL search parameters.

classes.name: Link
classes.description: React component representing a styled hyperlink that handles navigation with optional click behavior.

classes.name: LinkBadge
classes.description: Styled badge version of Link with optional dimming.

classes.name: ProjectLink
classes.description: Component that creates a link to filter test results by project name.

classes.name: AttachmentLink
classes.description: Component that renders a link or expandable view for test attachments, handling different content types and download options.

classes.name: TraceLink
classes.description: Component that provides a link to view trace attachments associated with test results.

classes.name: SearchParamsProvider
classes.description: Context provider managing URL search parameters for the report viewer.

classes.name: Anchor
classes.description: Component that scrolls into view when anchored via URL parameters.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Updates browser history and dispatches a popstate event to navigate to a new URL.

methods.name: useSearchParams
methods.description: Custom hook to access URL search parameters from context.

methods.name: useAnchor
methods.description: Hook that triggers a callback when a specific anchor ID is active in URL parameters.

methods.name: useIsAnchored
methods.description: Hook that checks if a given anchor ID is currently active.

methods.name: generateTraceUrl
methods.description: Creates a URL for trace attachments.

methods.name: downloadFileNameForAttachment
methods.description: Generates a filename for downloading an attachment.

methods.name: testResultHref
methods.description: Constructs a URL hash for linking to specific test and result in the report.
